item.description:
### Added - **Stop a Codex or OpenCode turn from your iPhone.** Stop was Claude Code only; it now covers three of the six agents Perch supports. Each one was measured first — Devin's and Amp's interrupt keys turned out to do something else, so they stay out until there is a key worth sending. - **Codex has one limit worth knowing.** Stopping works while Codex is thinking or running a tool, which is most of a turn. It does nothing during the few seconds Codex is writing out its final answer, and Perch cannot tell those apart — so a Stop tapped right at the end may not land.
### Changed - **Stop no longer appears when a session is waiting on a permission prompt.** Pressing Escape there does not stop the agent — it answers the prompt *No*. The button was quietly denying whatever was being asked, so it is gone for that case. Use Approve or Deny, which say what they do. Typing is unaffected.
### Fixed - **A denied permission no longer leaves a session stuck on "needs you".** Answering a prompt at the Mac used to leave the phone showing a request that had already been dealt with, sometimes for ten minutes. - Security and reliability improvements.
